annotation.title_clean: The National Artificial Intelligence Code of Ethics
annotation.title_en: The National Artificial Intelligence Code of Ethics
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship (Jordan)
annotation.venue: Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship, Jordan
annotation.summary_en: Bilingual Arabic-English national AI ethics code issued by Jordan's Ministry of Digital Economy and Entrepreneurship under the 2020 Jordanian AI Policy. Sets voluntary ethical principles (transparency, accountability, fairness, privacy, green AI), metaverse and research ethics, risks of non-compliance, and a ministry complaints channel. General AI, no robotics provisions.
key_provisions_or_claims: Voluntary ethical principles for responsible AI use, including transparency and explainability
Allocates responsibility and accountability for AI roles
Includes sections on Green AI, the metaverse and AI research ethics
Ministry creates a channel for complaints about AI ethics and assesses harm
Encourages open data and prototypes showing application of the Code
